name: Midas Capital fsAMM-HAY-BUSD cToken rounding loss
summary: Midas CToken.redeemFresh converted an exact requested underlying amount to the cTokens to burn with divScalarByExpTruncate, rounding the burn down. After reducing the fsAMM-HAY-BUSD market to 1,001 wei of cToken supply and donating underlying to inflate its exchange rate, the attacker repeatedly requested about 1.998 wei of underlying while burning only 1 wei; the remaining-supply guard did not activate because each redemption left exactly 1,000 wei. The inflated collateral position was then used to borrow and liquidate cash from three other Midas markets.

loss.notes: Gross loss is the exact pre-recovery depletion of external token balances in the three victim debt markets over the 17 value-bearing campaign transactions: fANKR 0x13ae975c5a1198e4f47c68c31c1230694dc44a57 lost 685999.702783572563751254 ANKR, fankrBNB 0xb2b01d6f953a28ba6c8f9e22986f5bddb7653aea lost 1148.264532617591819152 ankrBNB, and fHAY 0x10b6f851225c203ee74c369ce876beb56379fca3 lost 25296.116863562095022654 HAY. This excludes the attacker's flash liquidity and donated fsAMM-HAY-BUSD collateral rather than treating those circular inputs as victim loss. It also excludes later swaps and proceeds handling, and nets no recovery. The project post-mortem's approximately USD 340,000 pool-drain estimate corroborates this USD 332,253.20 component valuation; the legacy USD 600,000 figure described attacker proceeds/profit and is not a comparable victim-depletion measure.

ageReset.description: The market's sixth and last NewImplementation(address,address) event before the incident changed CDelegationStorage slot 0 from 0x1d48efba40d11c22315dd278e69268bca9dd5d7d to 0xf3c870b7c201515e2552d018ec2a15910fd35909. Slot 0 retains 0xf3c870b7c201515e2552d018ec2a15910fd35909 immediately before the anchor, and the anchor trace shows the market delegate-calling that artifact for the vulnerable redeemUnderlying and redeem paths.

sources.note: The selected transaction is the earliest successful defect-executing transaction by attacker EOA 0x4b92cc3452ef1e37528470495b86d3f976470734: at BSC block 29185769 index 40 it calls exploit root 0xc40119c7269a5fa813d878bf83d14e3462fc8fde, reduces the fsAMM-HAY-BUSD market to 1,001 wei supply, donates underlying, borrows against the inflated position, and performs the first under-rounded redeemUnderlying. Fourteen later successful transactions repeat the redemption, one self-liquidates, and the seventeenth reborrows the returned ankrBNB cash; they end at block 29185989 timestamp 1687021967. A successful call at block 29185947 emitted no logs and changed no measured value, so it is excluded as a no-op; later swaps are proceeds handling. Receipt Transfer logs netted by each victim market exactly match the pre-campaign versus post-campaign balance differences recorded in loss.assets. The target was internally CREATE2-deployed by 0xfc1f56c58286e7215701a773b61bff2e18a177de in source-6 at block 27304205. Its 618-byte delegator runtime is unchanged from deployment through the incident. CDelegationStorage slot 0 and six NewImplementation events establish the full implementation sequence: 0x62473df8 at deployment, 0x74517010 at block 27392990, 0x8e156d3c at 27539708, 0xb8729ec6 at 27543808, 0x13a2eb85 at 28121136, 0x1d48efba at 28886223, and 0xf3c870b7c201515e2552d018ec2a15910fd35909 at 29067669. The final event is source-9, and slot 0 still selects 0xf3c870b7c201515e2552d018ec2a15910fd35909 at block 29185768. That artifact was deployed in source-10 at block 29067248, and its runtime hash is 0x093da8322f7f3d19d6b2180caf9db93b3f62bf72824ee02523200b17adb41f87 at deployment, selection, and pre-anchor blocks. Although the market also routes extension functions to 0xe4fea88df81eba4f579208fa5abeb10aaf84e3f4, the anchor call trace shows redeemUnderlying (0x852a12e3) and redeem (0xdb006a75) delegate directly to slot-0 implementation 0xf3c870b7c201515e2552d018ec2a15910fd35909. The official vulnerable source uses divScalarByExpTruncate for redeemAmountIn; official commit 532bae69 fixes the exploit by rounding the burn up and includes a pre-incident fork regression test against this exact market and attacker call. The artifact was selected 355,231 seconds before the first defect execution.
